notes.title: Huge Enemy - huge update
notes.content:
Dear players, 

You had a sneek peek last week of all the changes done in Huge Enemy. But there is more! 

As a reminder, after two months of analysis and development we were happy to deliver an enhanced version of Huge Enemy - Worldbreakers.


[b]Following are the main new features:[/b]
[list]
[*] The concept has been rebuild from the ground, only one stick to move your ship and a button to shoot backward/forward. 
[*] No more crosshair, the targets in the background are now locked automatically. 
[*] Of course we kept the Dodge, Payback and Megaweapon actions. Still worth a try! 
[*] Full control gamepad either ingame and in the user interface.  
[*] More balanced challenge in both easy and hard mode. Casual and hardcore gamers will definitely fill their need!
[/list]

[b]We have also released the full OST for the occasion, by our composer Sebastien Navarro!
[/b]
Enjoy more than two hours of music. 
22 tracks of varied style like rock, ambient, jazz, electronic and even classical!


Have fun on this epic journey! 



[h1]More information about the changes:[/h1]

New interface mechanics
-Use Dpad or Arrows on keyboard to select and modifiy anything faster.
-With gamepad you do not need to pinpoint the option anymore.

No more Crosshair, No more Twinsticks
-You can now firing your weapons in front and behind you when you want.

Easy and Hard mode
-The difficulties have been rethought to match casual and pro gamer.
-Hard mode unlock more enemies and bosses to match the firepower you get in easy mode.
-The number of enemies per screen have been balanced.

Gamepad controls
-The gamepad commands have been rethought from scratch to give you a better gaming experience.

Life points
-Life points in easy mode have been multiplied by 2.

Damage Layover
-When you are hit, a bloody frame appear on screen only when your life have 3 life points left.

Payback Attack
-A better control have been updated for gamepad and keyboard.

Depth Bosses
-The firing system use now autotarget this way you can focus on your gameplay. 

Reshield
-On a boss fight reshield will target atomaticaly the first boss in front of you.
